title: Six Sigma Awareness Training
subtitle: Six Sigma Awareness course is designed to understand the Six Sigma process, overview of an DMAIC structured problem solving methodology, potential benefits of applying to your industry, set of tools to drive the process improvements and metrics.

points.text: Understanding the concept of DMAIC Approach

timeline_items.title: Training Content
timeline_items.description: A structured walkthrough of the Six Sigma body of knowledge, from its origins to the DMAIC problem-solving methodology.

points.text: DMAIC - A Logical Approach to Problem Solving
Overview of Tools used in Define Phase
Overview of Tools used in Measure Phase
Overview of Tools used in Analyze Phase
Overview of Tools used in Improve Phase
Overview of Tools used in Control Phase

timeline_items.title: Training Methodology
timeline_items.description: The course is delivered through an engaging mix of instruction, discussion, and assessment.

timeline_items.title: Who Should Attend
timeline_items.description: This course is ideal for anyone looking to build a solid foundation in Six Sigma concepts.

points.text: Students or any Professionals who wants to understand Six Sigma Concept

title: ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor Training
subtitle: Become a certified lead auditor. Learn to plan, conduct, and report QMS audits against the ISO 9001:2015 standard with confidence.

points.text: Master the ISO 9001:2015 requirements clause by clause
Plan and lead full audit cycles

timeline_items.title: Course Content
timeline_items.description: Five intensive days covering the complete audit lifecycle.

timeline_items.title: Who Should Attend
timeline_items.description: Quality professionals responsible for audit programs.

points.text: Internal Auditors moving to Lead Auditor

title: ISO 45001:2018 OH&S Management System Training
subtitle: Learn to establish, implement and maintain an Occupational Health & Safety management system that prevents work-related injury and ill health while proactively improving OH&S performance.

points.text: Understand ISO 45001:2018 requirements clause by clause
Identify hazards and minimize OH&S risks
Eliminate system deficiencies and address nonconformities
Improve OH&S performance and seize improvement opportunities
Prepare for certification and registration audits

timeline_items.title: Implementation Steps
timeline_items.description: A proven 14-step roadmap to implement and register your OH&S management system.

timeline_items.title: Who Should Attend
timeline_items.description: Professionals responsible for workplace health, safety and compliance.
